  • גבול צפוני / לבנון: דווח על מסגרת הסכם בין ישראל ללבנון (Good News ME/Fox) — הוצגה כמסגרת עקרונית. מומחים מזהירים שאיראן/חיזבאללה ינסו לסכל.

Good News

  • Domestic / logistics: Regional airports reported closed (Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan). Beit Aryeh sirens/IDF search active.
  • International moves: Pakistan mediating. UAE held rare security call with Iran about Hormuz. US domestic: Senate Republicans rejected a war-powers resolution.
  • 🟢 Good News: Israel–Lebanon framework signed — potential to reduce northern-front pressure; 10-day pause announced could create a negotiation window.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating.
